title: Johnny Costa - Data Engineer (EN)
summary: Data Engineer and Analyst with 3+ years of experience building ETL pipelines, cloud data solutions, and BI tools across financial services and automotive engineering (GCP, AWS, BigQuery, Python, SQL). Proven track record delivering measurable results: 80% ML recall rate in fraud detection, 60% SLA reduction, and 70% faster data preparation. Currently deepening expertise in AWS and Databricks.

bulletItems.text: Engineered an automated web scraping solution to collect and store 1,000+ vehicle records, reducing data collection time from several days to under 2 hours and establishing a reliable, continuously updated data source for engineering analysis (Python, BigQuery).

Built and automated an ETL pipeline to normalize and load vehicle data into BigQuery, reducing manual data preparation time by ~70% and enabling seamless consumption by 10+ downstream users and analytical tools (Python, BigQuery, GCP).

Optimized a Looker Studio dashboard querying terabyte-scale tables in BigQuery — implemented partitioning strategies that reduced query execution time by ~65%, delivering real-time access to key vehicle data for engineering decision-making (BigQuery, SQL).

Developing a full-stack internal data tool for Ford North America to replace manual Excel-based workflows — projected to reduce analysis time by 50%+, featuring user management, file handling, and interactive visualizations, with POC delivered and MVP in progress (Python, Streamlit, Pandas, PostgreSQL).

Designed an automated email monitoring workflow using Power Automate and JavaScript to track overdue tasks and notify supervisors in real time — eliminating ~3h/week of manual follow-ups and delivering a Power BI dashboard supporting Ford North America managers in reporting operational changes (Power Automate, Power BI, JavaScript).
Developed a scalable ETL pipeline in Python on GCP and BigQuery, reducing data loading and preparation time for vehicle data by 70%.
Co-developed a machine learning model for vehicle weight estimation, delivering predictive insights at total and subsystem levels directly used by the engineering team (Python, ML, Streamlit).
Automated data collection and transformation in BigQuery, creating optimized queries that reduced insight generation time by ~40% for the engineering team.
Built a Machine Learning model with Python and Apache Spark to predict fraudulent transactions, achieving an 80% Recall rate and significantly improving detection accuracy.
Developed a Python script to automate the identification of potential credit fraud, analyzing phone numbers, emails, and addresses, which made the process 80% faster.
Engineered and maintained ETL processes using Python, SQL, and Power BI, enabling proactive decision-making and reducing team response time by 65%.
Designed and modeled KPI dashboards using Power BI (DAX & M), saving a minimum of BRL 1 million by identifying fraud and improving customer contact efficiency.
Implemented the Kanban agile method using Trello, resulting in 50% more efficient and transparent task management for the team.
